snippet.title: Danganronpa Minus | Prologue 1/2 (Eng Sub)
snippet.description:
💦Download Link (Coming soon after fixing minor typos)
💥Special mention for today's video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3DLewv-OCto&ab_channel=ZoomSpace
They made this beautiful dead music, there's only a part being shared on the game so I wanted to share this dope remix to everybody, enjoy the full music on the link above!
Music used for the main menu : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WImK_98KFGY&ab_channel=NoteBlock
👻Also a few mentions regarding this game:

I was notified about this a few days ago, I didn't think this game was completed at the time and I went to check there are in fact 6 chapters, holy moly I thought. However there are not many CGs (Splash Art) in it, in fact this game uses several UI's from Danganronpa Another and AI art🤖 (some of the voices feel AI to me but I can't disclose that as fact and I don't wish to bring hate to this creator at all, just my personal input.) 

They created a game based on their own idea and everyone's free to make their story how they please, everyone is also free to think on how this game will affect content creation as well, so I welcome any opinions about it based on what you guys see in this story💫.
I figured this game was inspired on DR Another Despair Academy since there's a warning intro of this game mentioning DRA spoilers...Turns out there's quite a few taken images from Linuj's project...

...I honestly don't know how to feel about that.

The game script however is completely different from any fangame so at least there's original content there. And some of the maps and pixel art as well as sprite art are original creations to my knowledge. Still if you're a fan of DRA I know how this must feel, because I love DRA too. I will translate this game just to see how much work and inspiration was put on. If there are fans of this game then there must a reason for it, thank you all for watching and reading my thoughts on DR Minus⛔.
